basic_info.description: Gorgeous condo with private roof deck and panoramic views in Eureka Valley. Perched atop a boutique 3-unit building in the heart of Eureka Valley/Dolores Heights, this top-floor 3-bedroom condo offers iconic San Francisco living with sweeping views of the city skyline, Bay, and East Bay hills. The show-stopping private roof deck is ideal for morning coffee, sunset dinners, or entertaining under the stars. Inside, 1,254 square feet of sunlit space features a flexible 3BR layout with hardwood floors, double-pane windows, and a seamless flow from the updated kitchen to the formal dining and living rooms, perfect for both everyday living and special gatherings. A large private garage includes multiple storage areas, ideal for hobbyists or gear-heavy lifestyles. Enjoy peace and privacy just steps from the Castro's vibrant shops, dining, and Muni lines. With low HOA dues ($250/month), a new roof, fresh exterior paint, and in-unit laundry, this is a rare blend of convenience, charm, and world-class views. A true San Francisco gem.
